sceneTreatments.name: gallery-return
sceneTreatments.description: A measured empty-frame aperture grows around the visitor at scroll 66.6–69.0. The camera settles by 71.7. Reversed takeoff poses land on the shared perch anchor by 72.25; only the final rest pose samples the original painting, kept opaque through the background handoff at 72.26–72.34. The closing quote starts at 75.3713 after one additional viewport of rest. Gallery viewing holds are longer; no new assets.

sceneTreatments.name: amsterdam-gallery-bridge
sceneTreatments.description: The central bridge arch masks a forward camera passage at scroll 46.9–51.4. A traced opening and bounded canvas reveal the first real painting. 3.6 extra units preserve viewing holds. Bird emerges below the first painting; no new media.

sceneTreatments.name: vegas-amsterdam-sky
sceneTreatments.filter: Vegas: saturate(.87) brightness(.87); Amsterdam: saturate(.83) brightness(.9)
sceneTreatments.description: A viewport-sized canvas follows a climb, sky-only blend and descent at scroll 38.5–43.2. Three added scroll units preserve quotation holds. No new artwork.

sceneTreatments.name: shop-to-vegas
sceneTreatments.description: Approved glass-front cabinet option 3 masks a lateral cut behind its central door stile at story 28.35–29.95. Door faces and handles remain visible. No additional scroll time.

sceneTreatments.name: rainy-entrance
sceneTreatments.description: Generated connecting exterior with a measured doorway shell. Existing gallery and shop remain intact.

sceneTreatments.name: bird-study
sceneTreatments.limitation: Regenerated slimmer v4 atlas with the previous full-body animation restored. Source-art match awaits visual review.

editorial.restartWipe: 1.65s foreground pass using a dedicated 1254px transparent bird, preloaded near the gallery with the original atlas as fallback. Direct keyboard and reduced-motion return.
editorial.reflectionTreatment: Option C: foliate corners and open gold rails with fixed-size nine-slice border geometry, translucent umber backing and pale gold Source Serif 4 italic.
editorial.reflectionTiming: Quote appears over .5 score units; its note fades in from +.62 to +.96. No wall-clock delay.
editorial.resizeBehavior: Keep the current reading score through width and height changes; align the reading article to the current passage for short-window fallback and restore the cinematic position on return.

components.name: Restart control
components.description: Returns to the beginning under a 1.65-second foreground bird swipe on pointer activation. Keyboard activation and reading mode return immediately.
components.css: .ds-restart { display: inline-block; margin-top: 1.8rem; padding: .9rem .25rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gilt, #c9a24b); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--gilt, #c9a24b); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-restart:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-restart:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--gilt, #c9a24b); outline-offset: 6px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-restart:hover { color: var(--plaster, #d8d0bf); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-restart { transition-duration: 0s; } }

narrative.northStar: The world inside the panel, filmed on old stock.
narrative.overview:
This is an Experience surface. The interface withdraws so the visitor inhabits one continuous artwork. Scenes retain real architecture, perspective, light, and spatial depth, but the final impression is a painting seen through haze, grain, warm varnish, and time.

The bird is the visual continuity device. Camera, bird path and wingbeat, lighting, and text share one reversible scroll playhead. The implemented passage travels from the panel through rain and the Met, into the shop, past the selected glass-front cabinet into Vegas, then through painted sky into Amsterdam and beneath its bridge into the art gallery. The gallery now passes through the empty frame and returns to the original painting with a registered landing. All major passages are implemented locally; final artistic review and possible copy edits remain. The cutout study was rejected. The restored full-body animation with regenerated slimmer art awaits visual review.
keyCharacteristics: Old-master warmth interrupted by the cold canal blue of Amsterdam.
Crisp literary typography floating over atmospheric imagery.
Camera travel through retained painted architecture, controlled by scrolling.
Real paintings presented as themselves in the gallery finale.

rules.name: The Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Gilt, red wax, and canal blue earn attention because they are rare. Do not distribute them evenly through the experience.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Literature and apparatus may differ in scale, case, spacing, and posture, but never introduce a third typographic voice.

dos: Do make every transition feel continuous and reversible.
Do preserve real perspective and photographic light beneath the painted treatment.
Do keep the bird visually consistent and motionless when the visitor is motionless.
Do let the gallery paintings remain clear, real, and unobstructed.
donts: Don't divide the experience into visible chapters or navigable scenes.
Don't add sound, a progress indicator, or a return-to-Hijinx link in this iteration.
Don't perform snow, a whiteout, or other literal effects in Amsterdam.
Don't bake quotations into imagery or repeat their attribution after every passage.
Don't add motion that continues independently of scrolling.
